name: MoteMote – Love Story for Girls
source:
Three boys had a crush on you, and
they always argue and fight for getting you.

"I am the only one to save her!"
"She's the most important in my life!"
"How many times do I have to say? She is MINE!"

Who will be the one to get you?
The class president?
Your old and best friend?
Or a easy-going boy who is a transferred student from the U.S.?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.dual.motemote]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
三个男孩都迷恋你，并且
他们总是为了得到你而争论和战斗。

“只有我能救她！”
“她是我生命中最重要的人！”
“我要说多少次？她是我的！”

谁会来接你呢？
班长？
你最好的老朋友？
还是性格随和的美国转学生男孩？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.dual.motemote]Google Play[/url]]
